Figure 2. Overview of ID-Selection. Each token is assigned an importance score. For the LLaVA series [19–21], we adopt a unified score (Eq. (6)) that combines visual saliency ([CLS] attention [40]) and instruction relevance (Eq. (4)). Tokens with high scores are iteratively selected while suppressing similar ones to maintain diversity, until the token budget is reached, and the remaining tokens are pruned.
